summary: Inserts one vertex into a UI/2D primitive vertex buffer at index a2 (a2 in 0..15). Writes a 28-byte vertex record into the data array at this[6] (byte offset 0x18): position x computed from renderer constants plus a3, y/z from a4/a5, a constant 1065353216 dword, then a8 and a6/a7. Grows the stored count this[1] when the index exceeds it, and sets dirty flag bit 0x8000 on this[0]. Returns 0 on success; logs a wrong-vertex or too-many-vertices error and returns -1 when a pre-condition fails.

operations.description: Guard a2 <= 15 (max 16 vertices); on overflow log aTooManyVertice and return -1.
Guard this[0] bit 0x2 set (vertex insertion enabled); otherwise log aWrongVertexFor and return -1.
Grow the tracked vertex count: when a2 > this[1] - 1 set this[1] = a2 + 1.
Compute the byte offset into the vertex data array as 28 * a2 (28-byte stride per vertex).
Write vertex field at +0: flt_8B8CF0 * dword_8B8DD4 + flt_8B8CF4 * a3.
Write vertex fields at +4 = a4 and +8 = a5.
Write constant dword 1065353216 at vertex offset +12.
Write a8 as dword at vertex offset +16 and a6/a7 as floats at +20 and +24.
Set dirty flag: this[0] |= 0x8000 after a successful insert.
Error path: sub_53C590(-1, aWrongVertexFor) when the insertion-enabled bit is not set.
Error path: sub_53C590(-1, aTooManyVertice) when the index exceeds 15.
Listed as the vertex-insert routine invoked by 2D quad/rectangle/sparkle and related render helpers.
